back: The make-up of a population by age and sex.
Horizontal bar chart of males (left) and females (right) by age group, youngest at the bottom.
Base = births; sides = deaths; top = life expectancy; bulges and notches = booms, migration, wars, epidemics.
High birth rates (children as labour and security, little family planning, early marriage) with falling death rates.
Low birth rates (family planning, women's education and careers, cost of children) and long life expectancy.
Pension and care costs, labour shortage, fewer taxpayers; but elderly spending, volunteering, care jobs.
Close to 30% aged 65+ (approximate); fertility about 1.3; population falling since about 2010.
Zimbabwe: wide base, narrow top (youthful). Germany: narrow base, middle bulge, wide top (ageing).
